parameters.query:
SELECT
    sprint_id,
    issue_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        i.sprint_id,
        MIN(i.issue_id) AS issue_id
    FROM governanca_issues i

    LEFT JOIN governanca_sprints s
        ON i.sprint_id = s.sprint_id

    WHERE
        i.sprint_id IS NOT NULL
        AND s.sprint_id IS NULL

    GROUP BY i.sprint_id
) x

ORDER BY sprint_id::INTEGER;

SELECT
    s.sprint_id,
    s.sprint_nome,
    s.data_inicio,
    s.data_fim,
    s.time_nome,

    COUNT(i.issue_id) AS historias_da_sprint,

    COUNT(i.issue_id) FILTER (
        WHERE
            i.first_delivered_on IS NOT NULL
            AND (i.first_delivered_on AT TIME ZONE 'America/Recife')::DATE
                BETWEEN s.data_inicio AND s.data_fim
    ) AS historias_entregues,

    COALESCE(
        SUM(i.story_points) FILTER (
            WHERE
                i.first_delivered_on IS NOT NULL
                AND (i.first_delivered_on AT TIME ZONE 'America/Recife')::DATE
                    BETWEEN s.data_inicio AND s.data_fim
        ),
        0
    ) AS velocity_story_points,

    COUNT(i.issue_id) FILTER (
        WHERE
            i.first_delivered_on IS NOT NULL
            AND (i.first_delivered_on AT TIME ZONE 'America/Recife')::DATE
                BETWEEN s.data_inicio AND s.data_fim
            AND i.story_points IS NULL
    ) AS entregues_sem_story_points

FROM governanca_sprints s

LEFT JOIN governanca_issues i
    ON i.sprint_id = s.sprint_id

WHERE
    s.backlog = FALSE
    AND s.data_inicio IS NOT NULL
    AND s.data_fim IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY
    s.sprint_id,
    s.sprint_nome,
    s.data_inicio,
    s.data_fim,
    s.time_nome

ORDER BY
    s.data_inicio,
    s.sprint_id;
